title: Ancient Obsidian
description: This mod adds obsidian to minecraft version rd-132211 to rd-132328 which is why i called it Ancient due to those versions being made in 2009!
body: This mod makes a attempt to add obsidian to ancient minecraft version RD-132211 to RD-132328 with it being you need NO mod loaders since you have to inject the .jar file manually into minecraft heres a video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9DuYXK3mp60 Just instead of click replace minecraft click Add to minecraft.jar and then ignore the rest!
